mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SURVEY (SRVY_QITEM, CO_SN, COHORT_SN, SRVY_BGNG_DT, SRVY_END_DT) VALUES (#{srvyQitem}, #{coSn}, #{cohortSn}, #{srvyBgngDt}, #{srvyEndDt})
mapper.select: SELECT SRVY_SN AS srvySn, SRVY_QITEM AS srvyQitem, CO_SN AS coSn, COHORT_SN AS cohortSn, SRVY_BGNG_DT AS srvyBgngDt, SRVY_END_DT AS srvyEndDt FROM TB_SURVEY WHERE SRVY_SN = #{id}

SELECT SRVY_SN AS srvySn, SRVY_QITEM AS srvyQitem, CO_SN AS coSn, COHORT_SN AS cohortSn, SRVY_BGNG_DT AS srvyBgngDt, SRVY_END_DT AS srvyEndDt FROM TB_SURVEY WHERE CO_SN = #{coSn} ORDER BY SRVY_SN DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SURVEY SET SRVY_QITEM = #{srvyQitem}, CO_SN = #{coSn}, COHORT_SN = #{cohortSn}, SRVY_BGNG_DT = #{srvyBgngDt}, SRVY_END_DT = #{srvyEndDt} WHERE SRVY_SN = #{srvySn}
